task-11.description: Prepare a checklist for opening a business bank account
task-11.result:
[DRAFT CHECKLIST -- opening a business bank account, for review]

1. Complete business registration first (see task-12) -- most banks require a formed entity before opening a business account.
2. Obtain an EIN (Employer Identification Number) from the IRS -- free, done online, needed by virtually all banks.
3. Prepare formation documents and, since there are 2 co-founders, an operating agreement covering ownership split and decision-making.
4. Gather government-issued ID for each co-founder who will be a signer on the account.
5. Decide on an initial deposit amount (confirm the bank's minimum).
6. Compare 2-3 local/online business banking options for fees -- look for no/low monthly fees and free ACH transfers, given this is a lean, part-time operation.
7. Schedule the account-opening appointment (or complete the online application) -- a human must do this step; nothing above requires that yet.
